description:
Generate a design image (split primitive of design_apparel). Returns the raw generated image; follow with process_transparency for apparel that needs a transparent background. Rate-limit errors are classified (model_rate_limited = one model's provider vs platform_rate_limited = this key's ApparelHub throttle vs request_not_sent = the call never reached ApparelHub), and fallback_trail shows any model substitutions. When the platform has advice on the prompt it is returned as prompt_improvement (advisory, never applied for you). If its issues include "brand_brief", the prompt describes a whole brand, collection or storefront rather than one design, and improved_prompt is the single strongest design EXTRACTED from it: either generate that one design, or keep the brief and call again with concepts (4 is a good default) to get a themed set from one generation. With concepts > 1 this still returns ONE image; the other designs from the same generation are saved to the workspace and read with get_design_collection(image_uuid).

[#e5867b]

augment_prompt_for_transparency.description: Add the solid-green-background hint so the background can be keyed out (default true).

concepts.description: How many distinct design concepts to ask ONE generation for. Leave unset (1) for ordinary work. Raise it when the prompt is a whole brand or collection brief you want to keep (prompt_improvement reports "brand_brief"): the model is asked for a themed set instead of one image. Capped at 7 (ask for more and you get 7); the model may return fewer. Only sources whose supports_collection is true can do it (Nano Banana today); on any other source, including one the fallback ladder moved to, it is silently reduced to 1 and this tool says so in a warning. Costs ONE image generation either way, because it is one model call; the extra designs cost nothing. Each extra design carries the product name and retail description the model wrote for it.

no_fallback.description: Disable the model-fallback ladder. By default a rate-limited/transient model transparently retries with a different model (see fallback_trail); set true to fail on the chosen source alone.

size.description: Output shape. 1024x1024 = square; 1024x1792 = tall/portrait (phone cases, posters, banners); 1792x1024 = wide/landscape (mugs, laptop sleeves, wide banners). Pick to match the product's print area — full-bleed goods like phone cases want a tall design that fills the whole area, or the mockup pads/crops it. To re-shape an EXISTING design without spending another generation, use fit_aspect instead.

source.description: Explicit model name, or omit to auto-pick (Nano Banana; OpenAI for abstract).

name: generate_image
